method.kind: Node CPU code count and buildDynamic microbenchmark; not GPU or FPS
method.measurement: Median of 7 batch means in ms/buildDynamic; load, camera, GL sink and counting excluded from timing. Geometry and uploads include first and steady identical-frame counters.
method.timingCaveat: Node JIT, GC, host load and measurement order affect results. Compare repeated paired runs; these times do not predict browser/GPU FPS.
method.submittedCaveat: renderer.stats and explicit CPU command-sink counts only; no driver, GPU rasterization, visual check or framebuffer validation.
method.fixtureCaveat: Synthetic deterministic render fixtures, including upper-limit stress; not a recorded normal gameplay distribution.

measurement: CPU code counts and Node buildDynamic times only; not GPU/FPS or visual QA
timingWarning: Single paired run can be affected by JIT, GC, process order and host load. Deterministic counts are separate from noisy timings.
